blocks.text: SUBIC BAY FREEPORT — An aircraft maintenance facility based at the Subic Freeport has expanded its capacity to accommodate more business jets with the inauguration of a new 7,000-square-meter hangar at the Subic Bay International Airport (SBIA). Aviation Concepts Technical Services, Inc. (ACTSI) inaugurated Hangar B last week, according to the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA) in a statement on Thursday. The new facility can accommodate up to 10 long-range business jets or 12 large-cabin aircraft of mixed types, increasing ACTSI’s maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) facilities from 5,600 to 12,600 square meters.
